menu_options.app: With a Balkonaut app (Docker or add-on)

standalone.title: Choose devices
standalone.description: Which devices belong to your system? Balkonaut then suggests the matching entities, you check them in the next step. Leave empty what you don't have. If your devices are not set up in Home Assistant, leave everything empty and continue with OK: in the next step you enter their addresses under “Query devices directly”.

data_description.grid_device: Measures import and export at the house connection, e.g. Shelly Pro 3EM
data_description.storage_device: The main device, e.g. APsystems EZHI with battery or an inverter without battery
data_description.extra_device: A second inverter, e.g. an EZ1-M on the off-grid port of the storage
data_description.output_device: Plug that measures the output into the house, e.g. Shelly Plug

app.title: Connect Balkonaut app
app.description: Address of the Balkonaut app, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000

entities.title: Check entities

data_description.invert: Measurements whose entity reports the opposite sign, e.g. output to the house on the APsystems EZHI
data_description.hosts: Addresses of devices Balkonaut queries itself on the local network, without the manufacturer's integration, separated by commas, e.g. 192.168.1.11, 192.168.1.20. Detected: APsystems EZHI, Shelly Pro 3EM, single-phase Shelly (EM1), Shelly Plug, OpenDTU, AhoyDTU and Victron GX (MQTT or Modbus TCP). An entity mapped below takes precedence over the device.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.description: Optional, for the yield monitor: daily forecast per inverter from the Forecast.Solar integration. Without it, enter a plane later under Configure and Balkonaut fetches the forecast from Forecast.Solar itself.

summary.title: Summary

error.cannot_connect: Balkonaut cannot be reached at this address.
error.no_entities: Please select at least one entity or enter a device.
error.unknown_device: No known device answers at one of the addresses.

abort.already_configured: This Balkonaut app is already configured.

data_description.commissioned: From this day on the output meter counts, usually the commissioning date. Amortization then uses the real average instead of an extrapolation.
data_description.battery_name: Shown in the energy flow instead of “Battery”, e.g. the manufacturer. Devices do not report it reliably, so it is set by hand.
data_description.extra_name: Shown in the energy flow instead of “Zusatz-WR”, e.g. EZ1-M. If the inverter is its own device in Home Assistant, Balkonaut uses its model.

plane_storage.name: Plane inverter 1 with storage
plane_storage.description: For the daily forecast (yield monitor, optional) if no Forecast.Solar integration is assigned: Balkonaut then fetches it from Forecast.Solar itself. Azimuth 0 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west; tilt 0 = flat, 90 = vertical.

plane_extra.name: Plane additional inverter 2
plane_extra.description: Only if there is a second inverter.

error.future_date: The date is in the future.
error.incomplete_plane: Enter tilt, azimuth and power for a plane, or leave all three empty.

unreachable.title: Balkonaut unreachable
unreachable.description: Home Assistant has not reached the Balkonaut app at {url} for several polls. Is the container running and is the address still correct? This notice disappears once the app responds again.

missing_entities.title: Balkonaut: entity missing
missing_entities.description: These assigned entities no longer exist or are disabled: {entities}. Often the device integration has renamed them. Until then Balkonaut does not measure these values. Reassign them under [Balkonaut](/config/integrations/integration/balkonaut) → ⋮ → *Reconfigure*. This notice disappears once all entities are back.

unreachable_devices.title: Balkonaut: device unreachable
unreachable_devices.description: Balkonaut has not reached these devices for several queries: {hosts}. Is the device powered and on the network, does it still have the same address? On the APsystems EZHI, local mode must be enabled in the app. Balkonaut does not measure the affected values meanwhile. Change the address under [Balkonaut](/config/integrations/integration/balkonaut) → ⋮ → *Reconfigure*. This notice disappears once the devices answer again.

import_from_app.name: Import history from Balkonaut app
import_from_app.description: Imports the stored measurements of a Balkonaut app (Docker or add-on) into the standalone entry. Hours before its first own measurement are replaced by the app's more precise values, own measurements are kept.

url.name: App address
url.description: Address of the running Balkonaut app, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000
